# Renovatio: Pretender

**Version 1.0** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3809982416) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=renovatio-pretender&expanded=true)

Rome fell centuries ago, but its name still moves armies. Renovatio Imperii gives
that name to landed kings. This mod gives the road before the crown: a landless
adventurer who forges a Julian lineage, wins the people and the nobles of Roman
lands, and takes a first foothold — by uprising or by grant — to become
Renovatio's Roman Claimant.

**You do not start with land. You start with a story, and the desperate work of
making it believed.**

## Requires Renovatio Imperii

This is a submod. Load it **after Renovatio Imperii**. It depends on
Renovatio's Roman Claimant trait, its Renovatio Imperii casus belli, and the
old Roman borders region.

---

## Forge a Julian Genealogy

A landless adventurer can commission a family tree. Over one to two years, choose
an ancestor — Caesar, the people's general, or Augustus, the founder of order —
and gather the "proof": a bribed archivist, forged charters, a staged relic.
Each choice trades cost, time, and risk against **forgery quality**, a hidden
score that protects the secret later.

Finish, and you become a **Pretender to Rome**, carrying a **Forged
Lineage** secret. The camp's current county gains support.

## Win the people

Support lives on **counties inside the old Roman borders**, in three tiers:
Sympathetic, Supportive, and Fervent. Raise them with decisions:

- **Bread and Games** — spend gold to raise the camp county and perhaps its
  neighbours.
- **Speak in the Forum** — spend prestige for a focused gain where the camp
  stands.
- **Renown** — prestige earned from any source slowly turns into support
  where the camp stands.

Support fades where the camp is not, or near. Caesar-lineage pretenders gain
support faster.

## Win the nobles

Use **Seek Their Pledge** to ask a ruler with land in Roman borders to swear
to your cause. AI acceptance weighs opinion, your prestige, gold, hooks, shared
culture and faith, resentment of their own liege, and personality. Augustus-lineage
pretenders find nobles readier to listen.

## Road 1: Raise the Standard

With at least two pledged lords and at least three Supportive counties in your
camp's duchy, declare a **Rise for Rome** war. Each supportive county spawns
an army; each pledger sends a detachment. Win, and the counties are yours, the
cause becomes a claim, and Renovatio's world reacts.

## Road 2: Receive the Patrimony

A pledger with at least two counties can grant you one — never their capital.
You become their vassal, they gain a strong hook on you, and you receive the
**Bound by Oath** modifier. Rise against them while it lasts and the world
will call you oathbreaker.

## Either road makes you Roman Claimant

Once you hold land, the pretender trait becomes Renovatio's **Roman
Claimant**. You can immediately use Renovatio's reconquest war. Rebuilding the
empire itself stays Renovatio's work.

## The lie may be exposed

Doubters can uncover the forgery. If your support is still modest, the cause
collapses: counties abandon you, pledges break, and Roman rulers scorn you. If
the legend has already outgrown the lie — three Fervent counties or more — the
cause takes a blow but stands. If you are already landed, exposure is only
embarrassment; the claim is made in steel now.

## Heirs inherit the claim

A landless pretender who dies passes Pretender to Rome, the forgery quality, and
a fresh Forged Lineage secret to their heir. Pledges were personal and end.

## Compatibility

- Built and tested against **CK3 1.19 "Scribe"**.
- **Ironman and achievements:** this mod will disable achievements, as
  gameplay mods do.
- **Other mods:** requires Renovatio Imperii. It adds one trait, one secret
  type, several decisions, one interaction, one casus belli, modifiers, opinion
  modifiers, and events, and overwrites no base game file.
- **Existing saves:** safe to add mid-game. Remove the mod and any character
  holding the Pretender to Rome or Roman Claimant trait simply loses it.

## Languages

Available in all nine languages the game supports. English is fully written; the
other eight currently show the English wording. Translations are welcome.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `renovatio-pretender-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=renovatio-pretender&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
